verdict.rationale: RUN's own docs say users can run payroll online, by phone or in the mobile app. They also describe importing employee hours from timesheet files, AI error flagging before mistakes take effect, and automatic deposit on payday. Together these cover the core of running and submitting a payroll cycle. However, no evidence describes a single guided flow with an explicit review of hours and earnings or a preview of totals before submission. Missing for 10: documented review step for hours and earnings, preview of payroll totals before submit, explicit single end-to-end flow description, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run a full payroll cycle end-to-end — review hours and earnings, preview totals, and submit — in one flow

citations.quote: Run payroll online, by phone or even on-the-go with our mobile payroll app.
Instantly import into RUN your employees’ hours from the timesheet file you already use today
Help catch common payroll mistakes with AI-enabled error flagging before they impact your business.
On payday, pay is automatically deposited in each employee’s account.
